source: Sigstore public-good TrustedRoot (tlogs[].publicKey.rawBytes for baseUrl https://log2025-1.rekor.sigstore.dev), https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sigstore/root-signing/main/targets/trusted_root.json — mediaType application/vnd.dev.sigstore.trustedroot+json;version=0.1, validFor.start 2025-09-23T00:00:00Z. The logId equals the C2SP signed-note Ed25519 key hash SHA-256("log2025-1.rekor.sigstore.dev" || 0x0A || 0x01 || raw32), which matches the live /api/v2/checkpoint signature hint.
_comment: Rekor v2 shard log public key, pinned with provenance. NOT TUF-distributed to clients yet and rotates roughly every 6 months: when the active shard changes, ADD a new entry here. This file is embedded via include_str! at COMPILE TIME, so adding/updating a shard requires a rebuild + re-ship (not a pure runtime config swap). keySha256 is sha256(DER SPKI). The loader keys on logId/origin; url/source/fetchedAt are informational provenance, not parsed. New seals use the DEFAULT_REKOR_V2_URL const, validated at seal time against the active Sigstore TUF SigningConfig (a rotated-out shard aborts the seal). Verification resolves the key by logId, so frozen anchors keep verifying after rotation as long as the old shard's entry remains listed.
